name: io.github.Nomad07/arcagents-mcp
description: Arc Agents MCP: ERC-8004 agent data from Arc Mainnet. $0.002 USDC per successful request via x402.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet holding a small USDC balance on the payment network. Pays $0.002 per request via x402.

environmentVariables.name: ARCAGENTS_PAYMENT_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Payment network: arc (default) or base. ERC-8004 data always comes from Arc Mainnet.

environmentVariables.name: ARCAGENTS_MAX_PAYMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum payments signed per session (integer 1-1000, default 50).

environmentVariables.name: ARCAGENTS_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Total timeout for one tool call in milliseconds (1000-120000, default 30000).

environmentVariables.name: ARCAGENTS_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of a private directory for signed but unresolved payments, so they are resent, never replaced, after a restart (default ~/.arcagents-mcp).
